remarks: Welcome to Chesterfield, one of Stamford's most prestigious condominium complexes. This lovely townhome exhibits pride of ownership throughout: freshly painted and new carpeting as well as a refreshed kitchen with stainless appliances (microwave and dishwasher are brand new) and new quartz countertops. The main level boasts hardwood floors with an open concept living and dining room, wood burning fireplace and sliders to the deck. This level has a half bath. The Main and second bedrooms are on the upper level. The main bedroom, with it's vaulted ceiling and skylight, has an en-suite bathroom with double sinks, stall shower and hydro tub. There is a second full bath on this level. The Loft, with its two skylights and 2 generous closets, can serve as a third bedroom or office. The lower level has a carpeted family/guest room with corner fireplace, a full bath with tub/shower, as well as a bonus room with laminate floor. The bonus room is currently being used as an exercise room. The laundry is in this area. This lovely complex has it all: a gated community with two in-ground swimming pools and within walking distance to public transportation, restaurants and shopping. Close to highways and train station. A walk or quick ride to the fine dining and entertainment synonymous with vibrant Stamford and all it has to offer!
